tex_content.html:
Proposition
↗ prop:naturality-of-lie-brackets 1. ch5:5.9

If $M$ is an embedded (pseudo-)Riemannian submanifold of a (pseudo-)Euclidean space, its tangential connection is symmetric.

Proof

\sketch Let $\widetilde X,\widetilde Y$ be ambient extensions of $X,Y\in \mathfrak X(M)$. Naturality of the Lie bracket for the inclusion shows that $[\widetilde X,\widetilde Y]|_M=[X,Y]$ and is tangent to $M$. Hence

\[ abla _X^ op Y- abla _Y^ op X =\pi ^ op igl([\widetilde X,\widetilde Y]|_M igr)=[X,Y]. \]

□
